## Checklist

- [ ] This PR changes tests? → Does the test catch a real defect, not just confirm the author's assumption?
- [ ] Is content verified, not just form? (mode, parity, freshness — not just existence)
- [ ] If config changed: validated end-to-end? (reboot, metric read, alert fired)
- [ ] Does a new poller/timer have a self-staleness alert?
- [ ] Does TODO/FIXME have a corresponding issue?
- [ ] Is the change tested on staging (predator) before prod?
